bienvenida.errorServicio: Couldn't reach the local service. Check that the backend is running.
bienvenida.errorInicio: Couldn't start the connection. Try again in a few seconds.
bienvenida.intro: Authorise HT Lens through Hattrick's official connection. Then you can sync your squad, training, finances and matches whenever you choose.
bienvenida.sesionVencida: Your session has expired. Reconnect with Hattrick to continue; your saved data won't be lost.
bienvenida.paso2: If you manage more than one, you can choose which one to work with.
bienvenida.paso3: HT Lens doesn't run a full sync until you ask for it.
bienvenida.legal: HT Lens uses information from Hattrick.org with the permission of its owners. Your Hattrick credentials never pass through this application.
bienvenida.gratis: HT Lens is free. I pay for the server myself, US$7 a month.

setup.sinClub: Hattrick signed in your account but didn't return any team you manage.
setup.textoListo: Your real Hattrick data is now available. You can review the team, prepare the next match and follow training.
setup.textoYaImportado: This club already has imported data. You can go straight in or update it before continuing.
setup.textoNuevo: Confirm the club and decide when to bring in its players, matches, training and finances. Nothing is imported until you press the button.
setup.textoProxima: The next sync will keep your history and show only what's new.
setup.textoPrimera: The first import builds your history, so an empty list of changes isn't an error.

comun.sesionVencida: Reconnect to continue. Data you've already imported is kept.
comun.errorTexto: It may be a temporary hiccup. If it fails again, check that the HT Lens local connection is still up.
comun.sinDatos: This screen asked for its data and got no answer. Usually the HT Lens local connection is down.

apoyo.mensaje: Keeping this page online costs me US$7 a month, and I pay for it myself. If it's useful to you, support me or write to me in the guestbook: we can work together on new features.
